description: Remove ONE person from a project (their membership row only — the user account and the person's other projects are untouched). Identify them by `email` or `userId`; the remaining membership is read back to confirm and the removed list is reported. The project's other members are preserved.

email.description: Email of the person to remove.

projectId.description: Project id. Defaults to the connected project.

name: project_user_remove
title: Remove a user from a project (SimplifyQA)
